scope: Proposition 7.13 (Reduction to strict data with a controlled rest end) of the manuscript “The spacetime Penrose inequality and enclosing area” (preprints/The-spacetime-Penrose-inequality-and-enclosing-area-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 260 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 9bb0c350914915db), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 78. statement: Let (Ω, g, K) satisfy the exterior hypotheses of Theorem 7.2, including θ+ ≤ 0 on its smooth compact boundary, and let m = (E2 − |P|2)1/2 > 0. There is a sequence of smooth exterior data (gj, Kj) on Ω with the following properties: (i) µj > |Jj|gj everywhere and θ+,j < 0 on B. The constraint densities are integrable. On the end their DEC margin is bounded below by cjr−3−δ for some cj > 0 and one fixed 0 < δ < 1. For a smooth positive radius extension ρ, the constant can be decreased so that µj − |Jj|gj ≥ cjρ−3−δ on all of Ω. (ii) Kj is compactly supported, and in a rest chart gj − δ = Ok(r−1) and Rgj = Ok(r−3−δ) for every k. In particular Ricgj = O(r−3) there. Their ADM momentum is zero. (iii) (gj, Kj) → (g, K) smoothly on every fixed compact subset up to the boundary, their ADM energies satisfy Ej → m, and agj (B) → ag(B). Consequently it suffices to prove the energy/enclosing-area inequality for the class in (i)–(ii) in order to prove Theorem 7.2 in its stated class.
